meta.name: VisionQuest
meta.description: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

videos.title: No Strings
videos.overview: Vision embarks on a journey of self-discovery and finds himself haunted by a deadly force.

videos.title: Theseus
videos.overview: Vision comes face to face with his assailant while investigating whether Tommy Shepherd is his son.

videos.title: Reboot
videos.overview: Vision and Tommy Shepherd join forces in order to survive while a terrifying killer strikes again.

videos.title: Malware
videos.overview: As Vision confronts a new enemy, Ultron and Tommy Shepherd come face to face.

videos.title: Firewall
videos.overview: Ultron and Jocasta join forces. Lisa comes to Vision's aid to help him evade capture.

videos.title: Deadlock
videos.overview: Vision and Paladin form an uneasy alliance as Thomas finally learns the truth about his past.

videos.title: Immolation
videos.overview: Vision and Ultron's twisted relationship comes undone.

videos.title: Forever
videos.overview: Vision's quest to embrace his true identity comes to a close.
